American International Group Declares Quarterly Common Stock Cash Dividend, Payable on December 26, 2019; Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend on Series A 5.85% Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Payable on December 16, 2019. American International Group, Inc. announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share on AIG Common Stock, par value $2.50 per share. The dividend is payable on December 26, 2019 to stockholders of record at the close of business on December 12, 2019.The Board also declared a quarterly cash dividend of $365.625 per share on AIG Series A 5.85% Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a liquidation preference of $25,000 per share, which are represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/1,000th interest in a share of preferred stock. Holders of depositary shares will receive $0.365625 per depositary share. The dividend is payable on December 16, 2019 to holders of record at the close of business on November 29, 2019.

AIG Names Allison Barrett Head Of Multinational, General Insurance. AIG NAMES ALLISON BARRETT HEAD OF MULTINATIONAL, GENERAL INSURANCE.AIG - BARRETT WILL JOIN AIG ON DEC 9.
. American International Group, Inc. Names Allison Barrett Head of Multinational, General Insurance. American International Group, Inc. announced it has appointed Allison Barrett as Global Head of Multinational, General Insurance. Ms. Barrett will join AIG on December 9, 2019 and will be based in New York reporting to Michael Price, Head of Global Service Businesses & Global Chief Operating Officer, General Insurance. In this new role, Ms. Barrett will drive the execution of General Insurance’s multinational strategic plan and lead the worldwide delivery of the company’s multinational expertise and capabilities across product lines to AIG’s global clients and distribution partners. Ms. Barrett’s appointment builds on AIG’s 80-year leadership in providing clients with global risk management expertise and risk transfer solutions. Ms. Barrett joins AIG from Willis Towers Watson, where she served as Managing Director and Global Head of the company’s financial institutions business within the financial, executive and professional risk specialty group (FINEX) since 2017, serving banks, asset managers, insurers, REITs and FinTech companies.
